analytic_bound_audit.useful_finding: the proposed 2*T*2^-24*max|V| weighted-sum term was incomplete: runtime and reference also differ in score dot-product rounding, two-level (per-segment + reduce) online softmax vs single-level torch.softmax, Triton tl.exp lowering (typically ex2.approx.f32) vs accurate exp, normalization placement, and dequantization arithmetic (Triton fused multiply-add vs two-step PyTorch, which can flip a rare open-group BF16 value); gamma_n (n = D and the kernel's segmented L+S sums, not T) replaces n*u
reasons_not_adopted: FMA vs unfused dequantization not fully modeled
Attempt-4 capture cannot fully validate the bound (no per-element values, V_max, sum|q.k|)
PTX-specific checks would make the gate brittle

fixed_bf16_criterion_evaluation.result: FAILS (C1 passes 254/254; C2 fails at 60 checkpoints with a 1-ULP flip provably above the floor)
fixed_bf16_criterion_evaluation.structural_reason: runtime and ref_bf16 are both BF16 values, so any disagreement is >= 1 ULP; a 1-ULP gap relative to its reference is in (2^-8, 2^-7], so C2 with tolerance exactly 2^-8 requires exact BF16 equality for every away-from-zero element (except when the reference is exactly a power of two and the runtime value is the next lower BF16 number). Legitimate FP32-ordering rounding flips (unrounded relative error <= 2^-8 at every above-floor element) therefore fail C2.
